title: Fake Doctor
description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

title: River of No Return
description: This legendary tale, set on the Grand Canal, recounts the desperate journey of a crown prince, a minor constable, a female doctor, and a minor official-a fate that leaves no one immune. Constable Wu Dingyuan, female doctor Su Jingxi, and minor official Yu Qian must escort Crown Prince Zhu Zhanji from Nanjing back to Beijing within 15 days. Each with their own agenda, they embark on a journey evading ambushes and pursuers. Dodging danger and overcoming obstacles along the way, they ultimately rediscover themselves, each other, and the world.

title: Programming in Python
description:
In this course, you will be introduced to foundational programming skills with basic Python Syntax. You’ll learn how to use code to solve problems. You’ll dive deep into the Python ecosystem and learn popular modules, libraries and tools for Python. 
You’ll also get hands-on with objects, classes and methods in Python, and utilize variables, data types, control flow and loops, functions and data structures. You’ll learn how to recognize and handle errors and you’ll write unit tests for your Python code and practice test-driven development.
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
•	Prepare your computer system for Python programming
•	Show understanding of Python syntax and how to control the flow of code
•	Demonstrate knowledge of how to handle errors and exceptions
•	Explain object-oriented programming and the major concepts associated with it
•	Explain the importance of testing in Python, and when to apply particular methods
This is a beginner course for learners who would like to prepare themselves for a career in back-end development or database engineering. To succeed in this course, you do not need prior web development experience, only basic internet navigation skills and an eagerness to get started with coding.

title: Excel Skills for Business: Advanced
description:
This advanced Excel course is designed for business professionals, data analysts, and financial analysts seeking to master complex spreadsheet software for data-driven decision-making. Building on foundational Excel skills, this program will transform you into a power user, enhancing your employability and positioning you ahead in a rapidly evolving digital job market. (Source: World Economic Forum 2023 Future of Jobs Report).
By the end of this course, you will be able to:
- Master advanced Excel formulas and lookup functions for efficient data handling.
- Clean and prepare complex data for robust analysis using Microsoft Excel.
- Apply financial functions and date formulas for business calculations and reporting.
- Design and build professional, interactive dashboards in Excel for business intelligence.
To be successful, you should have completed the Excel Skills for Business: Essentials, Intermediate I, and Intermediate II courses, or possess equivalent intermediate Microsoft Excel proficiency.

description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

title: Ek Anjana Rishta
description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

title: PSYЯEN [Hindi]
description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "Psyren." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins-one that will change his fate forever.

title: Vicenta B.
description: A Cuban woman who can see into the future and communicate with spirits faces an existential crisis and confronts her own anxiety.

title: Plan B
description: A bookkeeper who thinks she killed three mobsters is subsequently promoted by her boss to be a hitman.

title: Nacional B
description: Live TyC Sports coverage of the second division of the Argentine football.

title: Akce B
description: Two years after the end of the Second World War, the remnants of Ukrainian Insurgence Army, called the Bandera's after their former commander Stepan Bandera, are trying to get from Poland through Slovakia to Germany in the West. They resort to sabotages also on Czechoslovak territory, and therefore army and police units are deployed to capture them. Soldiers and policemen are warned about the danger of encountering spies and collaborators of the Bandera's. In the meantime police investigators are arresting catholic clergy for supplying the saboteurs with weapons and false documents. Soldiers are operating in the area of Small Fatra, and it seems there must be someone amongst them who provides the Bandera's with information about planned movements of the army.

title: B-Side
description: When an underground radio DJ makes fun of a fading pop star who happens to listen to his show, the two begin an unlikely relationship. But difficult life and career crossroads jeopardize their idyllic New York romance.

title: B/B
description: The 2020 Tokyo Olympics are cancelled due to ministerial corruption, and there has been an attempted spraying of poisonous gas by a new religion. In the shadow of these two incidents, the murder of a convenience store owner has drawn a limited response from police and press but a suspect in the killing has been found: high school girl Sanagi (Karen), a loner who had an exchange with the victim's young son Shiro (NAKAZAWA Koshin). The axis of the film is her questioning by a psychiatrist and a detective but it won't be easy since she is suffering from multiple personality disorder and her personalities each emerge at random to recollect what happened from their respective perspectives.

title: Planet B
description: France, 2039. One night, a group of activists pursued by the state vanish without a trace. Julia Bombarth is one of them. When she awakens, she finds herself trapped in an entirely unfamiliar world: PLANET B.

title: Now Is the Time
description: In 1969, fifty years before this film is released, an indigenous community in Canada succeeds in constructing and erecting a totem pole, a practice which had been suppressed for decades by the local authorities.

title: Link Click S1-S3
description: Using superpowers to enter their clientele's photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at "Time Photo Studio," a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis.

Now he must keep his true identity hidden as their forbidden bond grows and the power buried within him begins to awaken.

title: C-38: The Search for Marriage
description: On June 22nd, 2005, Bill C-38 passed a final reading in the House of Commons, making Canada the fourth country in history to officially sanction same-sex marriages. Some saw it as the final hurdle in a 40-year marathon for equality. To others, it undermined an age-old building block of society. This controversial legislation continues to divide the country, and indeed the world, in half. Through interviews with the public as well as experts in various fields, 'C-38: The Search for Marriage' challenges common notions about marriage, sexuality and equality to answer these and other fundamental questions from an equal and fair perspective.

title: Joy of Life S1-S2
description: Fan Xian, born in the ancient empire of Southern Qing, inexplicably possesses memories from the 21st century. Wanting to learn about his mysterious past, he ventures to the capital, only to be entangled in the intrigues of the Emperor.

title: Quantum G-d
description: Quantum G-d is a 96 pages script and a presentation deck, for a science documentary, written, from the scientific optics, by scientists from the California Institute of Technology, Caltech, listed as the most important institute of technology in the world, and one of the main universities along with Harvard, MIT and Oxford. Throughout the script, the physicists formulate questions and provide the answers through different professional perspectives according to each area of study. This is accompanied with a series of mind blowing, never before seen animations that will be used in schools to teach quantum physics for an entire generation. The script, which includes the pointed questions and the novel animations, will challenge the top minds in theoretical physics to re-evaluate our ideas of how the universe works through the lens of quantum entanglement. One of the writers serves as the manager for Caltech's Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, and he was a scientific consultant in Marvel's blockbuster movies, including Ant Man, Spider Man Homecoming, Ant Man and the Wasp, Infinity War, Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, Avengers: Endgame and Fantastic Voyage (dir: Guillermo del Toro, prod: James Cameron). The narrative was constructed with the help of another scientist, a cell and molecular pathologist and research associate at the Doheny Eye Institute in Los Angeles, who co-wrote the viral shorts films, "Anyone Can Quantum" and "Quantum is Calling" which featured Stephen Hawking, Paul Rudd, Keanu Reeves, Zoe Saldana, Simon Pegg and John Cho respectively.

description: Following the publication of the first book about director Sidney J. Furie, this full-length documentary examines the life and career of the Toronto-born filmmaker. It is a journey that encompasses over 60 years, as we follow Furie's story from Canada to London and finally to Hollywood. In the midst of the 84-year-old Furie's biographical recounting, he directs two last personal projects, shot digitally on shoestring budgets, from the first solo scripts he has written since 1961. 'Drive Me to Vegas and Mars' is a comedy about aging and letting go, while 'Hannah Cohen' is a Holocaust-themed love story set and shot in Israel. The latter project is the culmination of a lifetime-long obsession with the Holocaust. Sidney J. Furie: Fire Up the Carousel is an intimate portrait of a unique, prolific, and quietly influential filmmaker, a man with an impressive resumé who has stood behind the camera on great films such as The Ipcress File (1965), Lady Sings the Blues (1972), The Boys in Company C (1978), The Leather Boys (1964), The Entity (1982), The Appaloosa (1966), Little Fauss and Big Halsy (1970), and many others.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

title: Hippocampus M 21th
description: The word "Hippocampus" was inspired by the hippocampus, a part of the brain located in the temporal lobe, which plays a key role in the learning process and in the formation of new memories about events lived. The letter M is a tribute to "M - The Monster of Dusseldorf" the film by Fritz Lang inspired crimes committed in Germany in the Twenties. description: Há seis anos, o presidente da Associação Mundial de Neurologia recusou convites de instituições médicas de elite para se dedicar a uma única missão, garantir a recuperação de uma pessoa extraordinária. Durante esse período, essa figura permaneceu em um quarto de luxo, com sua condição envolta em mistério. Não se tratava de um paciente comum – seis anos atrás, essa pessoa havia mudado o curso da história. Agora, com o despertar iminente, o mundo está prestes a testemunhar o retorno de uma lenda, cujas ações prometem transformar a realidade e trazer mudanças sísmicas.

title: Vice nalungkot sa kuwento ni nanay Rea
description:
Blessings have arrived kaya saluhin mo nang may ngiti sa mga labi. Five pogi heartthrobs have also arrived sa "It's Showtime" studio kaya times five ang kilig na sasakop sa puso n'yo!

Itinanghal na New Group Artist of the Year ng PPOP Music Awards 2025, WRIVE is here para haranahin ang Madlang People with their track "Hakbang." Espesyal rin ang araw na 'to dahil may espesyal na pagbati ng maligayang kaarawan para kay WRIVE Drei. At hindi lang si Drei ang may wish, syempre, lahat sila may big goals na gustong ma-achieve. Saan ba wish 'humakbang' ng grupo?

Mula Hinulugang Taktak, magfo-fall ang swerte papunta sa mga madlang players na sumalang sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Kaya makisakay na rin sa trip ng mga taga-Antipolo na naglaro!

Agaw-pansin ang nakaka-good vibes na awra ni player Rea, isang caddie sa golf club kung saan naglalaro si Ryan Bang. Ang ating oppa, nabigla sa pambubuking ni Rea, na sinabing galante siya at "mahilig sa magandang caddie." Napangiti na lang si Ryan, sabay depensa sa sarili, "Hindi ako 'yun!"

Pero pagkatapos ng tawanan at kulitan, naging seryso ang usapan nang ibahagi ni Rea ang hirap na pagkasyahin ang sweldo nila ni mister, na isang construction worker. Hindi raw maiwasan na paulit-ulit mangutang para sa pangangailangan ng tatlong anak. Naalala tuloy ni Vice Ganda ang isang eksena nila ni Nadine Lustre sa "Call Me Mother" kung saan bumitaw siya ng linya tungkol sa pagiging ina.

Nang makita naman ni Meme si player Louie, parang nakaharap daw niya ang kanyang kabataan, na parang kombinasyon din nilang tatlo nina Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario! Dahil parang tropa na ang vibe ng apat, tinulungan nila si Louie na manligaw on national TV!

Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the luckiest of them all? Si Cecille ang luckiest player na sumabak sa jackPOT round. Pero bago ang tawaran, napansin ni Vice Ganda ang 'costume' nina Karylle at Kim Chiu, na parehong may "injury." Biro ni Jhong Hilario, kung may BINI, sina Karylle at Kim naman ang BINA, as in BINAlot ng benda.

Itinodo ng BINA girls ang Li-Pot offer na umabot sa P35,000. Sa kabila ng pangungumbinsi ng Vice na subukan ang POT, mas pinili ni Cecille ang Li-Pot. Good decision! Kaya, Ate Cecille, congratulations!

Patuloy ang salpukan ng mga pambato ng NCR sa unang linggo na 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.'

Ang matinding bosesan, sinimulan ng pambato ng Caloocan na si Georgina Medina. Tinig niyang makabago, binigyang buhay ang "Love" ni Keyshia Cole sa entablado.

Tiwala sa sarili ay nais ibalik ni Kane Gabriel ng Mandaluyong City na buong-pusong inawit ang "You Will Be Found." Si Kane, may 'di magandang karanasan nang mag-perform sa isang big stage, kaya pakiusap ni Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo, magpatuloy lang ito sa pagkanta, "Don't give up because you have a beautiful voice." Paliwanag ni Maestro Louie, malakas ang dating ni Kane bilang mang-aawit, pero kailangan na maging maingat sa paglakas ng volume.

Sa dulo, itinanghal na panalo si Georgina sa score na 91.3%, laban sa 88.3% ni Kane.

title: Patrolman P
description: In 1971 the Knapp Commission, entrusted to expose corruption in the New York Police Department, faces a major problem. They have little physical evidence - their main source, Frank Serpico, won't wear a wire. They finally strike gold when a corrupt cop named William Phillips agrees to become their undercover agent, in exchange for immunity from a bribery charge. The evidence he eventually collects leads directly to the indictment of thirty New York cops. But the tables quickly turn when Phillips himself is convicted of a double-homicide. Three decades later and still in prison Phillips claims he's the victim of a massive police conspiracy.

title: Vice ibinahagi ang pangarap para sa relasyon nila ni Ion
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

#ShowtimeBabyDollsDay
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: AJAA may perfect anthem para sa mga KINAKABAHAN kay crush
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon? 

#ShowtimeNovemberGV
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Miss Q&A Rexy, UMIYAK nang matalo
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: Linda Walker natameme sa sagot ni Kelly sa Miss Q&A It's Showtime
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Sassa Gurl napadaan sa Miss Q and A
description:
Tayo'y always napapalingon sa kanyang mapulang blush, ang awrahan ni Sasa Gurl for today's video, deserve ng sash. Best in Costume 'yan? Ang Halloween, parang dumating in advance.

Humagupit na sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang bumabagyong kagandahan at wit ng mga kandidata sa "Miss Q and A."

Kung costume party ito, effortless si Miss Q&A Kulot ng Cavite, ang 'bunot' ni Vice Ganda for today. Pinag-sample ng gymnastics at pinakanta, pero ang hindi niya naipakita ay 'yung talent na kumagat ng bakal. Isa pang talent niya ay pasayahin ang Madlang People sa charisma niyang kamahal-mahal.

Umuwi man siyang 'lotlot' sa kompetisyon, nasungkit naman niya ang puso ng buong nation. Samantala, sina Chloe Castillo ng Isabela at Rhed Sicuan ng Las Pinas ang umabante sa Wit Lang round kung saan tuluyan nilang pinakawalan ang fierce na skill sa talakan.

Para kina hurado Max Collins, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves, mas matimbang ang bilang ng sagot ni Rhed. Siya ang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Susuyuin ng mga taga-Manuyo Dos, Las Pinas ang swerte upang masungkit nila ang Laro Laro Pick POT money sa “It’s Showtime” July 9 episode.

Enjoy ang hosts sa chikahan with Tin, na pangarap maging pulis noong kabataan pero ngayon makeup na ang kanyang fantasy. Kakaiba naman ang nickname ni Meow, ang solo parent na raketera queen.

Samantala, now showing ang Episode 4 ng Memerimar sa act-song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round. Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro) nagselos dahil para bang mas mahal ni Memerimar (Vice Ganda) si Fulgoso (Lassy). Dumating naman sina Senyora Angelika (Jhong Hilario) at Inocencia (MC) upang makipagsundo kay Memerimar. Pero ang batian, nauwi sa bugbugan!

Sa jackpot round, mabilisan ang naging tawaran nang tanggapin agad ni Lenlen ang Li-Pot offer na P30,000. Malaking tulong na kasi ito pra sa therapy ng anak niyang nasa autism spectrum.

description:

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

description: One fateful Saturday, Zelzah (Adrienne Rose White) receives a call out of the blue from her ex, Sazerac (Chris Mollica). Wearily, Zelzah decides to grab breakfast with him, which turns into a day-long exploration of the city of St. Louis - and their failed relationship. Over the course of the day, the film slips in time. As the two come together in the present, we see them fall apart in the past, their memories bleeding into their current conversations. title: Dívka s muslí
description: Thirteen-year-old Vendula (Dita Kaplanová) dozes off at school and dreams about her parents riding in a carriage dressed in their wedding clothes. The young teacher is angry with the girl who has already failed a year, and has no idea that she is looking after three younger half-brothers. They all have a different father and their mother (Evelyna Steimarová) comes home noisy and drunk every day, often accompanied by a man. Early in the morning, Vendula helps her mother clean offices, and sometimes has to do the cleaning all by herself. Her eldest brother Libor is good at school and blindly adores his mother. Jeník is a talented flute player and much more cynical. The youngest Venousek is still a toddler. The only one who is cared of is Vendula by her father (Ladislav Frej), who has divorced his confirmed alcoholic wife years ago and has another daughter in his new family. All his attempts to persuade Vendula to move in with them are in vain. The girl is selflessly trying to keep the family together.

title: The Care They've Earned
description: It is a gripping look into six proud veterans' experiences with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) as they seek to manage the mental and physical trauma they sustained in uniform. The documentary details their experiences with an embattled VA - from botched surgeries to misdiagnoses to personnel shortfalls - and educates about the fundamental changes and reforms that are needed to ensure our veterans are taken care of in a way that honors their service. It asks viewers to reflect on serious and complex questions about what kind of care our veterans have earned after they hang up their uniforms and when, how, and where they receive that care. The Care They've Earned tells the stories of six veterans, but it highlights the struggles of finding adequate health care that all veterans face. It educates about the opportunity that more choices could mean for our veterans to receive the care they need - when and where they need it.

title: The Last Lions
description: Fifty years ago there were close to half-a-million lions in Africa. Today there are around 20,000. To make matters worse, lions, unlike elephants, which are far more numerous, have virtually no protection under government mandate or through international accords. This is the jumping-off point for a disturbing, well-researched and beautifully made cri de coeur from husband and wife team Dereck and Beverly Joubert, award-winning filmmakers from Botswana who have been Explorers-in-Residence at National Geographic for more than four years. Pointing to poaching as a primary threat while noting the lion's pride of place on the list for eco-tourists-an industry that brings in 200 billion dollars per year worldwide-the Jouberts build a solid case for both the moral duty we have to protect lions (as well as other threatened "big cats," tigers among them) and the economic sense such protection would make. And when one takes into account the fact that big cats are at the very top of the food chain-and that their elimination would wreak havoc on all species below them, causing a complete ecosystem collapse-the need takes on a supreme urgency.

title: Robot Taekwon V vs. Goldwing
description: The fourth movie in the popular Korean movie series Robot Taekwon V.

title: Murder in Polná
description: An exciting drama from a detective history. In 1899 a dead girl - seamstress Anezka Hruzová - was found between the village of Veznicka and the town of Polná. She was 19 and she had a cutting wound on the throat. There was no sexual violence involved and since the local doctors thought that there was not enough blood on the crime scene, everyone jumped to the conclusion that Jews must have killed her and added her blood to their pass-over matzot. There was a potential murderer at hand too - a cheeky, not very bright young Jewish rover, Leopold Hilsner...

title: V for Vendetta
description: In a future British dystopian society, a shadowy freedom fighter, known only by the alias of "V", plots to overthrow the tyrannical government - with the help of a young woman.

W
description: Terminally ill Madame Europa languishes at her last post in the company of her Chinese man-machine. There is a sadomasochistic relationship between them. They are on the run from a war that is inexorably approaching through the darkness.

title: W Wish
description: Juuna Tono is a boy without a past. Orphaned by a tragic accident that claimed the lives of his parents and his memory, Juuna and his younger twin sister Senna have only survived by their commitment to support each other. But when a strange girl greets him as "Big Brother" (onii-chan) Juuna turns to her and says, "Haru...hi?" It is someone from his forgotten past, who Senna claims is his childhood friend - or is she?

title: Salma w Sari
description: Salma and Sari is about two young Palestinians who find themselves in a situation they weren't ready for. The series is set in East Jerusalem, where life under Israeli occupation is stressful and pressure leads to aggression. Their friends and family make it difficult for them to make their own decisions and follow their dreams. Salma is only eighteen. She grew up without a father, and pressure on her mother to protect Salma from society grows. Salma has a passion for photography, and struggles to convince her mother to support her goals. She has to take matters into her own hands, to follow her dreams, whatever the cost. Sari didn't go to college and works at his family business. He's good at what he does, but that's not good enough for his family. As he reaches the age of twenty four, his family insists it's time to marry and start a family. Sari's friends have different plans for him. They are young, bored, and love cars. And you know what that means - trouble. This creative drama for social change is set in East Jerusalem and other areas in the West Bank.

title: masakra w
description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

description: The series revolves around the family of Moulay Ahmed, one of the most famous merchants in Casablanca, a father of six daughters, who dreams of having a son who will inherit his wealth and lineage. Moulay Ahmed's wife, Anber, discovers that the gender of her fetus is a girl again.

title: A.W.O.L
description: Vietnam. 1972. US Army Special Forces Major Cliff Marquette leads a squad ordered to investigate unusual reports and secure a remote jungle temple locals believe has mystical powers. The Marines guarding the temple have withheld provisions for days from a Viet Cong prisoner. Despite severe mistreatment, the prisoner mysteriously shows no signs of suffering. Marquette confronts the Marine in charge, Garris for torturing a prisoner of war when suddenly enemy forces attack and mortar shells rock the temple. An exceptionally heroic, but losing battle lands Marquette in the hands of a merciless Viet Cong torturer. His men are dead; his screams unheeded. At the height of agony, Marquette's world is turned upside down. In an instant, he finds himself a stranger in the midst of an American life that apparently belongs to him - an idyllic but unrecognizable life complete with a loving wife and two children he's never seen before. Marquette struggles to take in what is happening to him. First is paranoia. Soon uncertainty and fear give way to relief and acceptance. But the twist of fate that delivered Marquette into this life from the hands of his enemy has granted him only a reprieve. The cruel pain of war is not over. As the clock strikes midnight Marquette is back in Vietnam where his torture resumes a few minutes each night. Desperately trapped between two worlds, Marquette must endure;unless, with the clock counting down, he can cheat fate. Escaping will take his wits;and it will require a gun.

Yamini, as a singer, aspires to reach greater heights in the music industry with her singing talent. She hangs out a lot and doesn't take things seriously in the process, all three become good friends, and because Swaranjali and Vardhan love each other, they begin a living relationship, with Swaranjali morally and financially supporting Vardhan. In the process of introducing her live music painting theme to the world, she meets famous event organizer Rakesh, but Rakesh, being a playboy, wants every girl to be around him rather than helping them. As a neighbor, Papua irritates Swaranjali by knowing about her relationship with Vardhan and tries to attract her while she avoids him. Swaranjali planned a surprise party for Vardhan's birthday and invites all for the party. Vardhan was discovered dead in Swaranjali house on the same day.How does Swaranjali get out of this murder mystery and achieve her goal?

title: X
description: A homicide detective awakens in a strange house and cannot remember what happened the night before. Upon arriving at work, he's assigned to the investigation of a brutal case of murder in which he may well be the killer. Passionating suspense. Un detective de homicidios despierta en una casa extrana y no puede recordar que ocurrio la noche anterior. Cuando llega al trabajo, lo asignan a un caso brutal de asesinato. Y el puede ser el asesino. Apasionante suspenso.

title: Vagabundo y millonario
description: After failing to locate a kidnapped millionaire, the chief of police fools an identical-looking tourist to pose as the kidnapped gentleman to fool the criminals into letting him loose.

title: Nina y Laura
description: An essay on grief.

title: Aquí y Allá
description: "AQUÍ": Pedro returns home to a small mountain village in Guerrero, Mexico after years of working in the US. He finds his daughters older, and more distant than he imagined. His wife still has the same smile. Having saved some earnings from two trips to the US, he hopes to now finally make a better life with his family, and even to pursue his dreams on the side by starting a band: Copa Kings. He cherishes the everyday moments with his family. "ALLÁ": The villagers think this year's crop will be bountiful. There is also good work in a growing city an hour away. But the locals are wise to a life of insecurity, and their thoughts are often of family members or opportunities far away, north of the border. While working in the fields, Pedro meets and begins to mentor a teenager who dreams of the US. That place somehow always feels very present, practically knocking at the door. "Aquí y Allá" is a story about hope, and the memories and loss of what we leave behind.

title: Sueños y caramelos
description: Sofia's grandfather is the head security guard at a huge department store, "El Gran Almacen". At night, while her grandfather guards the store, Sofia uses her imagination to turn the department store into a world of fantasy and dreams. She decides to tell her friends about this new world, and she and her friends have many adventures there. She meets a new boy, Juan, whom she believes is a poor orphan--but in fact he's the son of Mauricio, the department store's owner, and his biggest fear is that he'll lose her friendship forever if and when she discovers his true identity.

title: Tú y yo
description: The Mrs., an old widow, and Aridia, her maid, live in isolation in a house in Santo Domingo where they have domestic chores to keep them occupied. Their relationship is tense, but as the end of the day, they know they only have each other.

title: Pablo y Carolina
description: Torn between three lovers and bored by her typewriting classes, Carolina (Dillian) writes a passionate love letter to fictional Pablo Garza from Monterrey. The letter is sent by mistake and received by real Pablo Garza's girlfriend. Pablo himself (Infante) flies to Mexico City looking for an explanation. Carolina is rehearsing a musical show for her school dressed as a man. When Pablo meets her, she pretends to be her brother Anibal, a shy and feminine sailor. Pablo likes Anibal and invites "him" to a cabaret. After that, Carolina falls inlove with Pablo but resists to unveil her real self. Meanwhile, Pablo feels himself confused, because young "Anibal" is cute as an angel and has "those blue eyes..."

title: Estudiantes y modistillas
description: Soledad and Lola work as seamstresses in a typical Madrid neighborhood. When Julio, a law student from a wealthy family, leaves Soledad pregnant and abandons her, she asks for help to the Paloma Virgin. Julio becomes a barrister, and has to defend an abandoned woman. Realizing his own faults, he will now get back to Soledad. Shot in Madrid on location in the Retiro park, Puerta del Sol, Paloma Church and other spots of zarzuelistic fame.

title: ¿Y los tamales?
description: A Honduran cabbie is entrusted with picking up a payload of tamales for Christmas Eve. On his journey, he picks up some spicy characters that all have their secrets to hide. Together, they take a long taxi ride into comical redemption.

title: Terror y feria
description: Collection of small, independent stories, with the premise that all of them are terror/bizarre related.

title: Vas-y Coupe!
description: A motley crew of laborers makes the yearly trek to a vineyard in France's Champagne region to pick grapes for a famed winemaker, but as his son begins to take the reins it is unclear if this harvest tradition can endure. A pure vérité portal into two disparate French worlds entwined.

title: Chasing Luck(Y)
description: A man who plays lottery for years suddenly wins 4 million euros, despite his previous lack of success. However, a winning ticket somehow finds its way to the hands of local pub's owners. After finding out that the police and two local crooks are after them, they escape to Greece, but their hosts mistakenly make announcement of the lottery winners over all mediums. From that point, everybody sets out on the way to Greece hoping to find the missing ticket.

title: La Habana y Barcelona. Esplendor y Ruinas
description: Havana and Barcelona have much in common. The Catalan Indians built extensively in Havana and you can also see many similarities in Barcelona's Paseo de Gracia or in the uptown's grand houses. Nowadays, Barcelona has become home to many talented Cubans: artists, musicians, doctors and unique but ordinary people. In this film, they sing, dance and explain their experiences in Barcelona, and how much they miss their own land. They get excited, cry and laugh. They tell us how they have adapted to life in this brotherly country, but different, colder and more formal. They talk about the special period caused by the fall of the Berlin Wall, and also about medicine and Afro-Cuban culture.

title: Esposa y amante
description: Luisa's daughter has attempted suicide. While attending the clinic and, looking at the state of her daughter, she remembers the first happy years of her marriage to Peter, a popular and friendly sports journalist. Soon after came the first deceptions of her husband.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, a frustrated detective, receives a second chance when he is forced to adopt his 10 year old brother (who happens to be a child prodigy). With his help, Franco will solve the most complicated mysteries.

title: Marcelo y María
description: In the sixteenth century, two young indigenous fall in love, but being slaves, they will have to submit to their masters or fight for their love at all cost.

title: Cásate y Verás
description: The adventures and misadventures of married couples at different stages of life with humor and laughter.

title: Lucho y Ramos
description: An absentminded burglar is caught in the act by the owner of the house he's stealing.

title: ¿Y ahora que?
description: 13-episode Documento-fiction series whose aim is to help boys and girls who are going through puberty to understand the physical, hormonal, social and emotional changes that take place at this stage of life.

title: Oro y Polvo
description: The real-life story of a drug cartel leader set to Macbeth.

title: Mariana y Scarlett
description: Amor, desamor, envidia y traición son los ingredientes de la nueva novela Mariana y Scarlett, la historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son dos mujeres de clase media, bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran anhelo de superación. Pero ahí terminan los parecidos. Mientras Mariana es seria, dulce, serena y quiere hacer todo por el camino correcto; Scarlett es divertida, pícara, agresiva y quiere hacer todo por el camino rápido. El deseo de la primera es montar su propio taller de confecciones y hacer sus propios diseños, el de la segunda es ser una modelo internacionalmente reconocida. En su camino hacia el cumplimiento de su sueño ambas se cruzarán con Roberto White, un millonario dueño de una textilera, cuyo matrimonio está roto y que, mientras consigue el divorcio, saldrá con las dos hermanas pero con identidades diferentes. Con Scarlett será Roberto, millonario y empresario, mientras que con Mariana será Boby, empleado en una agencia de seguridad. Cuando Roberto se da cuenta de que se ha enamorado de Mariana, romperá con Scarlett, pero la dicha no lo durará mucho, ya que Mariana no tardará en descubrir el engaño, lo que le llevará a romper con él para siempre. Scarlett por su parte descubre que Roberto la abandonó por Mariana, lo que hace que su relación de hermanas se afecte de manera irreversible. Scarlett y Mariana se convierten entonces en rivales por la lucha del amor de un hombre, Roberto.

title: Juan y Vanesa
description: When Juan, a 35-year-old truck driver learns he has a daughter, he decides to become responsible. He quits alcohol and takes one last chance at his job, to deliver various goods to Mexico City. At a gas station, Vanesa, a Mexican Lolita with pink-dyed hair convinces Juan to let her go with him. A rebellious teenager and a broken man start a journey where they confront each other and their own demons only to realize that this strange encounter can awake something unexpected and beautiful in them.

title: Las dos y media y... veneno
description: The old Don Senén has squandered in sprees the inheritance of his niece Begoña rather than manage it. There is still a million pesetas, which will only be delivered after the death of Don Senén. To get it, the old man, in complicity with Begoña and two other nephews (Ramón and Marcos) will fake his death. But Ramón and Marcos really planned to poison their uncle putting cyanide in his milk to keep them with money - When poor Quintín, Justo and Paloma (funeral parlor's workers) arise at Don Senén's home they will find an overview full of misunderstandings.

title: Rocío y José

description: A young man, Yu Narukami has moved from Tokyo to Inaba to stay with his uncle and cousin, while his parents are away on business. Accompanied by his friends, Yu explores another world inside the TV, that seems to be connected with the murders. They also discover the ability to summon 'Personas', their 'other selves', whose power they can use to fight the shadows that inhabit the TV world. title: My Lucky Star
description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

title: Still a Family
description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

description:
कक्षा 4 हिंदी प्लेलिस्ट में आपका स्वागत है! यह संकलित वीडियो कलेक्शन कक्षा 4 के छात्रों के हिंदी सीखने के मार्ग में मदद करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। चाहे आप छात्र हों, शिक्षक हों या अपने बच्चे की सीखने को समर्थन करने वाले माता-पिता हों, यह प्लेलिस्ट आपकी मदद करने के लिए यहां है।

इस व्यापक प्लेलिस्ट में, आपको कक्षा 5 हिंदी पाठ्यक्रम के विभिन्न विषयों और अवधारणाओं को कवर करने वाले वीडियो देखने को मिलेंगे। प्रत्येक वीडियो को स्पष्ट और सरल तरीके से प्रस्तुत किया गया है, जिससे छात्र सामग्री को प्रभावी ढंग से समझ सकें।

प्लेलिस्ट पाठ्यक्रम के साथ मेल खाती है और मूलभूत अवधारणाओं से शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे उन्नत विषयों की ओर बढ़ती है। वीडियो व्याकरण, शब्दावली, पठन समझ, लेखन कौशल और हिंदी साहित्य जैसे महत्वपूर्ण क्षेत्रों को कवर करते हैं |

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

title: Guns & Gulab
description:
This story is a high-voltage romantic thriller set against the backdrop of crime, power, and emotional conflict. It explores the journey of Naina, an innocent yet resilient girl, whose life takes a drastic turn when she crosses paths with Kabir Ahuja—a ruthless mafia don who falls obsessively in love with her.
The narrative blends intense romance with action, betrayal, and family drama. At its core, it questions morality, power dynamics, and the meaning of love—whether love can be forced or must be earned.
With strong emotional stakes, dramatic twists, and a dominating male protagonist versus a morally grounded female lead, the story promises a gripping mix of passion, revenge, and transformation.

Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

title: Nakli Pati Nikla Crorepati [Hindi]
description: Lakshya Oberoi—India’s youngest billionaire—was never meant to be anyone’s husband. But a one-night stand with fiery Tanya Goenka traps him in a dangerous contract marriage built on lies, lust, and survival. As Tanya battles her scheming stepmother, jealous stepsister and ruthless ex-fiancé, secrets unravel and enemies close in. In a world of stolen identities and deadly conspiracies, Lakshya must decide if Tanya is his greatest weakness—or the only ally who can save him.

title: Queen Of Snakes
description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.

title: Unknown Connection
description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

description:
Mafia Girl is a high-voltage romantic crime drama with dark humor and emotional depth.

At its heart, it asks—can love survive when it is born in violence?

description: నింగ్ షియావో ఒక బాహ్య దేవుడి ఆత్మ యొక్క శకలాన్ని వెంబడిస్తూ మానవ లోకానికి చేరుకుంటాడు. జోంగ్ క్వింగ్‌ను రక్షించి, ఆమె కుటుంబానికి సహాయం చేస్తాడు. బాయి కుటుంబం మరియు అతని మునుపటి నిశ్చితార్థి బాయి జిక్యూయు ఆయనను తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు. కానీ, వారి వర్గాలలో ఉన్న ఒక ద్రోహిని బయటపడతాడు. బాహ్య దేవుడిని సంహరించిన తర్వాత, బాయి కుటుంబం ఆయన అసలు మహత్వాన్ని గ్రహించి, గతంలో చూపించిన అవమానానికి పశ్చాత్తాపం వ్యక్తం చేస్తుంది.

description: Enter the 24th Ward, a man-made island inside Tokyo Bay. Three of its inhabitants: Shuta, Ran, and Koki, have been best friends since childhood, but after a deadly incident, everything changed. A year later, reunited for the first time, they receive a mysterious phone call. On the other line is a familiar voice from a friend who's supposed to be dead. Together, they'll have to save their home.

description: Handyman Saitou has never felt special in his life. When he's dropped into a medieval fantasy world, he gathers a party of unique beings to survive. Surrounded by a heavy warrior, a spell-forgetting wizard, and even a divine fairy princess, he yearns to be helpful. But after Saitou saves everyone during a raid, it's clear that having a handyman on an adventure isn't just useful, it's essential.

title: A Blonde for a Night
description: After an argument, a newlywed decides to test her husband's fidelity by disguising herself as a blonde.

title: A Girl. a Guy. a Ford. a Love Story.
description: A husband and wife argue about what to do with their old truck.

title: A Burglar for a Night
description: In Hong Kong, William Neal helps Kirk Marden fight off a group of rowdies. Back in New York, Kirk again turns to William's assistance when his father's rivals plot to take control of the Marden railroad. William teaches Kirk how to open safes so that Kirk can procure papers outlining the takeover plans. While Kirk is robbing the safe, Janet Leslie, daughter of one of the conspirators, enters, and Kirk forces her to marry him so that she cannot testify against him. Kirk succeeds in reconciling his father with his rivals and in winning his new wife's love.

title: A Bit of a Stranger
description: Four generations of Ukrainian women from one family explore how their ethnic identity has been destroyed and embark on an emotional journey shaped by their new found memories and family history.

title: A Glória e a Graça
description: Graça is a single mother who works as a massage therapist and lives with her two children: Moreno, 8, and Papoula, 15. One day, in a visit to the doctor, Graça is diagnosed with a brain aneurism that may rupture at any moment. Desperate about who will take care of her kids in the event of her death, she decides to go after her brother, Luiz Carlos, whom she hasn't seen in over 15 years due to a quarrel. When they meet, however, Luiz Carlos has become Gloria, a beautiful and successful transvestite, who now owns a restaurant and brags about being independent. At first, Gloria is unwilling to reconnect with her family; but as she becomes more guilt-stricken, she accepts Graça's invitation to meet her nephews and eventually realizes that maybe, to be complete, she needs to become a mother.

title: A Day Like a Week
description: The film follows the interrogation of Stan Truman. He tells an interrogator a convoluted story about events that led him and his family to experience a mysterious night.

title: A Day at a Time
description: Alba and Anastasia are twins with cerebral palsy who touched the heart of President Clinton with their plea for equal access. They come from an extraordinary family where everyone is determined the twins will be included in all activities. The fact that they are both in wheelchairs does not keep them from school, summer camp, or church. Their mother, Mary, thinks nothing of carrying them up and down several flights of stairs in their wheelchairs. She is a woman in constant motion, bathing, dressing, feeding and taking pleasure in seeing the twins are attractively dressed. She uses her tenacity and charm to assure that her children receive all the medical and educational benefits to which they are entitled. The filmmakers became close to the family, capturing the milestones of their lives: a birthday party, days at summer camp, their joyous first communion in church. Filmed over a period of four years, this unforgettable story will inspire everyone concerned with the challenges of family life and the place of disabled children in our society.

title: A Day in a Life
description: Paris. Gabrielle and Enzo, two teenagers from the same gang, meet in front of the school. Cigarettes, the affirmation of sexual desire and the discovery of new drugs punctuate their day. Each one, in his own way, celebrates or laments childhood that is slipping away.

Before Zima knows what's happening, the witch has cast a switching spell and run off into the woods, while Zima is left behind in Baba Yaga's hut - and Baba Yaga's body.
